subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in WAC-30. (C)ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality): the question is what alternative-composite-progressionalism does once it enters social reality — the structural shape of the Euro-American intervention. ALT-C-PG outputs to SOC-RT (the crossing). ALT-C-PG also branches to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and to ALT-F (alternative functionalism). ALT-F then carries EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), which branches to RT-DY (reality dynamics), to TR (transformation) → PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism), and by a *dashed* edge to LK-IMP (linkage implications); a *dashed* edge also runs from TR → TH-CONT (thrust continuance). Per Braxton's legend, a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to. Structural argument: alternative composite progressionalism reaches transformation only via the alternative-functionalism → expansion-dynamics chain, with progressional extended functionalism as terminal output.
